managedSelfHosted.description: More reliable and low-maintenance self-hosted Pangolin server with extra bells and whistles
managedSelfHosted.introDescription: is a deployment option designed for people who want simplicity and extra reliability while still keeping their data private and self-hosted.
managedSelfHosted.introDetail: With this option, you still run your own Pangolin node - your tunnels, TLS termination, and traffic all stay on your server. The difference is that management and monitoring are handled through our cloud dashboard, which unlocks a number of benefits:

benefitSimplerOperations.title: Simpler operations

benefitAutomaticUpdates.title: Automatic updates
benefitAutomaticUpdates.description: The cloud dashboard evolves quickly, so you get new features and bug fixes without having to manually pull new containers every time.

benefitLessMaintenance.title: Less maintenance
benefitLessMaintenance.description: No database migrations, backups, or extra infrastructure to manage. We handle that in the cloud.

benefitCloudFailover.title: Cloud failover
benefitCloudFailover.description: If your node goes down, your tunnels can temporarily fail over to our cloud points of presence until you bring it back online.

benefitHighAvailability.title: High availability (PoPs)
benefitHighAvailability.description: You can also attach multiple nodes to your account for redundancy and better performance.

benefitFutureEnhancements.title: Future enhancements
benefitFutureEnhancements.description: We're planning to add more analytics, alerting, and management tools to make your deployment even more robust.
